title: Asset repository
description: Describes an asset repository: a folder below assets/ whose files are installed with the package (assets/<ID>/asset.json). The file itself is not an asset.

descriptions.description: Description by language code. The empty string is a description; a language without entry has none.

description.description: Label of the repository by language. English (en) is mandatory.

folders.description: Folders with descriptions, or folders that do not exist on disk such as empty ones.

files.description: Information on single files by path. A path with languages is language-dependent: each language maps to a file of the folder, which is then reachable only as variant of this path. A file at the path itself is the language-independent version.

mimeType.description: Media type, overriding the one derived from the extension.
